task.title: Migrate benchwork/web package management and CI workflows from npm to Bun

receipt.summary: Closed on benchwork main at 9c41c4f, developed on feat/bun-migration after unarchiving the ticket (it was one of the tasks archived by the bulk pass) and claiming it first. web/bun.lock replaces package-lock.json, produced by bun install migrating the npm lock so resolution is identical rather than recomputed; package.json pins packageManager bun@1.4.4; CI installs Bun via oven-sh/setup-bun and runs bun install --frozen-lockfile then bun run build so a stale lock fails instead of silently re-resolving; Playwright boots the dev server with bun run dev; CONTRIBUTING now describes the Bun toolchain it actually uses. Verified locally: bun 1.4.4 frozen install reports no changes across 278 packages, bun run build exits 0, chalkline docs check reports 9 present 0 missing 0 drifted, and the generated dist bundles were reverted so the commit carries the migration only.

events.description: DONE on benchwork main. web/bun.lock replaces package-lock.json (generated by bun install migrating the npm lock, so resolution is identical rather than recomputed); package.json pins packageManager bun@1.4.4; CI installs Bun via oven-sh/setup-bun and runs bun install --frozen-lockfile then bun run build so a stale lock fails instead of silently re-resolving; Playwright boots the dev server with bun run dev; CONTRIBUTING describes the Bun toolchain. BENCHMARK, measured sequentially with identical lockfile content and node_modules removed (macOS Apple silicon; Node 24.21.0, npm 12.0.2, Bun 1.4.4): install with a cold package cache 27.89s npm versus 13.21s Bun (2.1x faster); install with a warm package cache 15.22s versus 1.13s (13.5x faster); build via tsc -b plus vite build 27.58s versus 29.32s, so about 6 percent slower because tsc and vite remain Node programs Bun does not accelerate. The win is resolution and linking, which is what CI pays on every run. The numbers live in benchwork CONTRIBUTING rather than only in a commit message.
